steps.title: Prepare Tissue for Quenching
steps.instruction: Ensure tissue has undergone secondary antibody incubation and has been rinsed 3 times with TBS for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Quench Autofluorescence with Cupric Sulfate
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue sections in cupric sulfate solution to reduce autofluorescence from lipofuscin granules.

substeps.instruction: Place cupric sulfate solution into the wells of a six-well tissue culture plate
Transfer tissue sections into the wells
Incubate at 4 °C with shaking for 30 minutes

steps.title: Rinse Tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue sections using TBS to remove the quenching solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the tissue to the wells of a tissue culture plate containing TBS
Rinse the tissue 3 to 4 times in TBS with shaking for approximately 10 minutes per rinse

steps.title: Mount Tissue
steps.instruction: Mount the processed tissue on slides and apply coverslips using mounting media.
